ds.emailError: Check the address: there must be a domain after @, e.g. mail.ru
ds.noteBody: Cheshuika is booked from 10:00 to 12:00. Pick another time or dragon.

sayt.introLead: Phone first, from 320 px. Styles live in
sayt.heroLead: Banded sky, clouds, a rental meadow, and a dragon chasing a flaming pearl. The name sits in the header as a logo; copy and CTA are centered. This is the only live place on the page. The sky follows the theme: sunset by day, night by night. A plain blue day sky is kept in reserve and is not shown by default.
sayt.heroCopyLead: Pick a dragon and a convenient time.
sayt.buttonsLead: One primary button on screen. Hover, press, Tab through: every state is live.
sayt.capBlock: Full width: main form action on phone
sayt.fieldsLead: Label always above the field. Error below: icon, what went wrong, how to fix it.
sayt.fieldEmailHintText: A 6-digit code will arrive at this address
sayt.statusesLead: The client sees two statuses: booking and payment. Full list with rules: Foundations tab.
sayt.catalogLead: Sprite on a pastel tile, name, one line of blurb, hourly price and a button. Hover: the card lifts one step.
sayt.dragonCheshuikaAbout: Calm, loves clouds and thyme tea. Good for a first flight.
sayt.dragonCheshuikaFull: Calm, loves clouds and thyme tea. Good for a first flight: flies level, stays low, warns before turns.
sayt.dragonLunAbout: Chases the pearl and brings rain. Smooth flight, no jerks.
sayt.dragonGorynychAbout: Three heads and one kind heart. Room for the whole family.
sayt.dragonRyuAbout: Image failed to load: an egg on a calm tile instead.
sayt.dragonLead: Dragon and description on the left, four-step booking panel on the right. One column on phone.
sayt.rateHint: Every started hour is billed in full.
sayt.periodFree: Cheshuika is free for this slot
sayt.periodChecking: Checking if the dragon is free
sayt.periodError: End must be at least one hour after start
sayt.contactsLead: Two fields and one button. On the right: the same form after a failed send.
sayt.emailHint: We will send a 6-digit code. It is valid for 10 minutes
sayt.sendFailedBody: Check the address and try again in a minute.
sayt.otpLead: Six large digit cells. Try typing or pasting: the cursor moves on its own. The resend timer is running.
sayt.otpHeading: Enter the code from the email
sayt.otpInvalid: Code did not match. Attempts left: 4
sayt.otpExhaustedCap: Out of attempts or code expired
sayt.otpExhaustedBody: Out of attempts. Request a new code.
sayt.resultLead: Number, dragon, period, total and payment status. The number uses a regular font so it is easy to dictate.
sayt.demoPayment: Taken by the manager at pickup
sayt.conflictLead: While the client entered the code, someone else took the slot. No booking is created; the message says what happened and what to do.
sayt.noteOk: Booking DR-001025 confirmed. See you on 25 November at 10:00.
sayt.noteInfo: Only future dates can be booked. Shortest rental: 1 hour.
sayt.noteWarn: The code is valid for 2 more minutes.
sayt.emptyLead: A small picture, one line about what happened, and one action.
sayt.emptyCatalogBody: The dragons have not hatched yet. Check back later.
sayt.emptyErrorBody: Check your connection and refresh the page.
sayt.emptyLoadingBody: Big loader: the pearl flies in a circle. For a whole page or section.
sayt.empty404Body: Maybe the dragon flew to another address.
sayt.footerLead: Name, catalog link, language, and an icon credit line if a CC BY set is used.
sayt.credits: Dragons and icons are drawn in code. An author line is needed only if Streamline Pixel is linked: "Icons: Streamline, CC BY 4.0".
